notes: Aether is now a multi-game hub. The loader picks a shelf by place id before it downloads anything: Arsenal (combat, tuned), Flying Tesla Roadster (vehicle tools), or Universal (every module, untuned). The Games page shows which shelf is active and restarts into another one. New Tesla page: infinite cold gas, and an auto-pilot where you middle-click a spot, scroll to set its height while a scriptable camera holds it in view, then drive there - with saved spots for the places on the map you keep going back to.
